recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A clean brand end-card frame in 16:9 landscape format. The entire background is a solid deep navy blue (#222946 — a dark saturated blue with a slight purple undertone, darker and more definitively blue than a standard navy, similar to a deep midnight blue; hex approximately #1f2644). There are no photographic elements, no textures, no objects, and no gradients visible in this frame — only solid flat color. The composition is completely centered. In the horizontal and vertical center of the frame, a white (#ffffff) brand wordmark is displayed in a single horizontal line: the wordmark reads 'kakaobank' using a clean, modern, geometric sans-serif Latin typeface — the word 'kakao' is set in regular or light weight, and 'bank' is set in bold or black weight, creating a visual weight contrast within the single word; both are in the same typeface family with consistent letter spacing (slightly tracked out, clean optical spacing); the wordmark is approximately 25–28% of frame width; letter height approximately 8% of frame height. The wordmark is centered at approximately 50% from left and 50% from top — perfectly centered in the frame. Below the wordmark, with approximately 22% of frame height vertical spacing, a single centered line of small white Korean body text reads '자세한 내용은 카카오뱅크 모바일앱을 참고하세요.' — the text is in the same sans-serif family in regular weight, white (#ffffff), approximately 1.5% of frame height in font size, centered horizontally. No other elements exist in the frame — no decorative graphics, no yellow brand elements, no mascot, no icons, no additional text lines, no lines or dividers. The deep navy background appears uniform to the eye — no vignette, no gradient, no subtle texture. The overall lighting is purely digital and flat — no directional light source, no shadows, no highlights. Color palette: #222946 (background dominant deep navy), #ffffff (wordmark and disclaimer text only). The mood is confident, minimal, authoritative — a clean brand closure. Style anchor: Korean mobile bank brand end card, flat digital design, 2018-era Korean fintech brand aesthetic, clean typography-only lockup, 4K, perfectly minimal. Looking at the wordmark more closely: the letter 'k' in 'kakao' has a conventional geometric sans structure; the 'bank' portion's heavier weight creates a natural reading emphasis shift — the eye reads 'kakao' first (regular weight, longer word) then 'bank' (bold weight, shorter word) in a single unified brand name. The inter-character spacing within the wordmark is slightly tighter than default to maintain visual compactness. The disclaimer text below uses the same typeface family in regular weight, with approximately 200% of the wordmark's line height as the vertical gap between them, ensuring they read as distinct elements on the same visual axis without crowding. There are no decorative elements anywhere in the frame — no underlining, no box rules, no icons, no decorative punctuation — just the wordmark and disclaimer in white on deep navy. The frame's four edges are clean with no vignette darkening. The overall aesthetic is precise, confident, and restrained — the visual language of a modern Korean digital bank brand that communicates through simplicity rather than ornamentation. This end card functions as a brand signature that closes the emotional narrative of the advertisement with authority and clarity. The deep navy color (#222946) is consistent with the brand's established color identity visible in the title card (shot 1), creating a visual bookend that gives the advertisement a coherent structural frame from open to close.

inferred_creative_thinking.insight: The person who manages dues for a club gets all the cheering but none of the practical help — they carry a hidden burden invisible to others
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: a middle-aged Korean serving as treasurer or organizer for a community group (hiking club, alumni association); tech-hesitant but overwhelmed by analog dues tracking
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: sitting alone on the bus while everyone else celebrates, holding a paper ledger, realizing the app could have made all this easier
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: the app is not just a bank feature — it is practical solidarity; it does what cheerleaders won't: actually help
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: 응원만 하고 도와주진 않으니까 — the app is the one that helps
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: specifically built for group dues management up to 100 members — not generic banking, a tool designed for this exact human situation
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: KakaoBank is the friend who shows up and does the work, not just the cheering

inferred_brief: Launch KakaoBank's group account feature targeting adult club organizers frustrated by manual dues tracking; use relatable slice-of-life scenario to establish empathy then demonstrate the app as practical solution
